title: Enterprise IT questionnaire
lead: SIG Lite–style answers for procurement and security review. Live posture (SSO mode, MFA, RBAC pilots) loads from the public API when configured — we do not claim features that are not enabled in your environment.

items.question: Do you support enterprise SSO (SAML/OIDC)?
items.answer: Staff authentication supports Nest password, Keycloak OIDC, or dual mode (STAFF_AUTH_MODE). SAML/OIDC via Keycloak is available when PTT_STAFF_KEYCLOAK_ISSUER is configured. The live posture panel shows the current mode for this deployment.

items.question: Is MFA enforced?
items.answer: OTP MFA is required for positions listed in STAFF_MFA_REQUIRED_POSITIONS (default: GDKD and super-admin). Other roles follow your IdP policy when SSO is enabled.

items.question: Can IT use Permission Sets instead of editing the full matrix?
items.answer: Yes — Permission Sets are available on the staff RBAC admin path when PostgreSQL staff is enabled. Sets bundle section caps and can be assigned per user.

items.question: Do you support row-level lead scope?
items.answer: Client/workspace scope for leads is available when STAFF_SCOPE_PILOT=1. This is a pilot capability for agency multi-client deployments — not a substitute for full ABAC.

items.question: Where is production data hosted?
items.answer: Singapore (AWS ap-southeast-1) unless contractually agreed otherwise. See Trust Center → Data residency.

items.question: Do you offer a DPA and SCCs for EU/UK?
items.answer: Yes — /en/legal/dpa and sub-processor DPAs (AWS, Stripe). SCCs apply per vendor DPA where data leaves the EEA.

items.question: Is data encrypted in transit?
items.answer: TLS 1.2+ for all public and staff paths. Object storage and database use provider encryption at rest.

items.question: SOC 2 status?
items.answer: SOC 2 Type I is in progress. A report link appears on the Trust Center only after PO and auditor sign-off — never before.

items.question: Can we export audit logs?
items.answer: Staff RBAC and GTM actions are audit-logged. Enterprise access-review ZIP export is on the WIN roadmap; contact sales for current export options on your contract tier.

items.question: What is your uptime commitment?
items.answer: 99.9% monthly target for marketing site, demo API, and public CMS read. See /en/status for live component health and incident history (published only after measured production days).
